kernel: agent-generated SM107 small-M MXFP8 (E4M3 + UE8M0 block-32, 1D swizzled 128x4 scales) NT GEMM, bf16 out (csrc/mm_mxfp8_smallm_sm107.cu)
note: Dispatch surface of mm_mxfp8's 'specialized' backend. backend='auto' routes to it only on the exact (M, N, K) shapes below: the shapes where the kernel beats the strongest stock configuration with margin on BOTH measured stock arms (the latest release and current main's autotuned ranking) on SM107 under CUDA-graph timing. Every other call keeps the stock path. An explicitly selected backend is never swapped and never falls back: backend='specialized' that cannot serve a call raises NotImplementedError with the refusal reason; only backend='auto' routes around a refusal. The allowlist is exact membership, not a range: off-list shapes measured slower (the kernel's generic route, which is also the green-context fallback for clustered routes, is capture-safe but unmeasured against the stock backends), so near-miss shapes must not be added without re-measuring.
